arxiv-2502-05452.title: Improvement in Autocorrelation Times Measured by the Master-Field Technique using Field Transformation HMC in 2+1 Domain Wall Fermion Simulations
arxiv-2502-05452.creator: Nobuyuki Matsumoto
arxiv-2502-05452.description: Abstract The Field-Transformation Hybrid Monte-Carlo (FTHMC) algorithm potentially mitigates the issue of critical slowing down by combining the HMC with a field transformation, originally proposed by Lüscher and motivated as trivializing the theory. For the transformation, we use a single invertible discrete smearing step inspired by the Wilson flow but which resembles a Jacobian-computable generalisation of the stout smearing step.

arxiv-2502-19400.title: TheoremExplainAgent: Towards Video-based Multimodal Explanations for LLM Theorem Understanding
arxiv-2502-19400.creator: Max Ku Thomas Chong Jonathan Leung Krish Shah Alvin Yu Wenhu Chen m3ku@uwaterloo.ca, thomas.chong@votee.ai, wenhu.chen@uwaterloo.ca University of Waterloo Votee AI Vector Institute
arxiv-2502-19400.description: Abstract Understanding domain-specific theorems often requires more than just text-based reasoning; effective communication through structured visual explanations is crucial for deeper comprehension. While large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance in text-based theorem reasoning, their ability to generate coherent and pedagogically meaningful visual explanations remains an open challenge.

arxiv-2504-00596.title: Generalized free wreath products and their operator algebras Thanks: P.F. is partially supported by the CNRS IEA GAOA
arxiv-2504-00596.creator: Pierre Fima, Arthur Troupel
arxiv-2504-00596.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pierre Fima, Arthur Troupel. We develop a new approach on free wreath products, generalizing the constructions of Bichon and of Fima-Pittau. We show stability properties for certain approximation properties such as exactness, Haagerup property, hyperlinearity and K-amenability. We study qualitative properties of the associated von Neumann algebra: factoriality, primeness and absence of Cartan subalgebra and we give a formula for Connes’ T T -invariant. Finally, we give some explicit computations of K-theory groups for C*-algebras of generalized free wreath products.

arxiv-2510-22146.description: Abstract Over a bounded strictly convex domain in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} with smooth boundary, we establish a priori gradient estimate for an anisotropic mean curvature flow with prescribed contact angle and Neumann boundary conditions. The estimates require careful analysis of the degeneracy property of the anisotropic mean curvature operator.

arxiv-2510-26919.title: Scattered light noise due to dust particles contamination in the vacuum pipes of the Einstein Telescope

arxiv-2510-26919.description: Abstract High-sensitivity optical measurements such as those performed in interferometric Gravitational Wave detectors are prone to scattered light noise. Nonetheless, the effectiveness of these measures can be undermined by other sources of scattered light.

pmc-13234007.description: IntroductionM2 type macrophages could promote oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) progress.
